label: 侧坐后仰
pose_lead: Grounded pose, side-sit leaning back on one hand:
lower_limbs: Both legs bend and gather toward the same side, one leg in front, the other folded behind.
upper_limbs: One hand is placed on the ground behind the body, the other resting close to the body or a leg.
torso_head: The upper body leans back yet keeps the chest open, the shoulders carrying a slight rotation; the head upright.
weight_silhouette: Weight concentrates on the hips and the rear supporting hand; the legs spread sideways while the torso forms a backward diagonal.
